## Notes

One AI answer built to earn trust: AI label, confidence, inline citations, sources and feedback.

## Props (AIResponseProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | The answer. Put <Citation n={1} /> markers where a source backs a claim. |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | Header label. @default "AI answer" |
| `model` | `React.ReactNode` | Optional model or assistant name shown beside the label. |
| `confidence` | `number` | 0 to 1. Shows a ConfidenceMeter with the percentage. |
| `confidenceLevel` | `'high' \| 'medium' \| 'low'` | Explicit confidence level when there is no score. |
| `sources` | `AISource[]` | Numbered in the order the citations use them. |
| `status` | `'streaming' \| 'done' \| 'error'` | streaming: caret + Stop, sources hidden. error: message + Try again. @default "done" |
| `onStop` | `() => void` |  |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` |  |
| `onCopy` | `() => void` |  |
| `onRegenerate` | `() => void` |  |
| `feedback` | `'up' \| 'down' \| null` | Controlled feedback state. |
| `onFeedback` | `(value: 'up' \| 'down' \| null) => void` |  |
| `disclaimer` | `React.ReactNode` | Footer note. Pass "" to hide. @default "AI can make mistakes. Check the sources before you act on this." |
| `errorMessage` | `React.ReactNode` | @default "I couldn't finish this answer." |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>._
